title: Duleep Trophy Final: Ishan Kishan and Kumar Kushagra Score Centuries
summary: In the Duleep Trophy final, East Zone's Ishan Kishan was nearing a double century, reaching 385/5 on Day 2. He was later joined by Kumar Kushagra, who also scored a century. The coverage focuses on the batsmen's performances against the bowlers.
